hook.text: In concrete, gravel is the strong stuff. Cement paste holds it all in place.

buildup.text: The reinforcement carries the load — fibers, particles, or flakes that provide strength.

discovery.text: The matrix surrounds and protects the reinforcement, transferring stress between fibers.

twist.text: A great fiber in a weak matrix wastes potential — the interface between them is everything.

climax.text: Carbon fiber is useless as loose thread. Embed it in epoxy and it outperforms steel.

punchline.text: Reinforcement provides strength. Matrix provides teamwork.

quiz.question: What is the role of the matrix in a composite?
options: To carry all the structural load
To surround reinforcement and transfer stress
